name: get_party_member_position_y

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetPartyMemberPositionY uses the top value to index the three-object party registry at D_002DEC00 and replaces it with the integer-converted position Y float at object offset 0x14

notes: This is the Y-coordinate counterpart of command 290 get_party_member_position_x and command 292 get_party_member_position_z. A null party slot leaves the input value unchanged. All 329 JP calls pass a direct slot: 297 use slot 0 for the player, 16 use slot 1, and 16 use slot 2. Nine calls join commands 290 and 292 as an X/Y/Z position triple.
